test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: general
question: PQR is an equilateral triangle and the centroid of triangle PQR is point A. If the side of the triangle is 12 cm, then what is the length of PA ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In an equilateral triangle, the distance from a vertex to the centroid is equal to the circumradius (R).

Direct Formula: PA = side ÷ √3

PA = 12 ÷ √3

PA = (4 × 3) ÷ √3 = 4√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Side of equilateral triangle PQR (a) = 12 cm. Point A is the centroid.

**Formula Used:** Height (h) of equilateral triangle = (√3/2) × a; Centroid divides the median in the ratio 2 : 1 from the vertex.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8503c0d28ebdc663e643f22ba9d4cbc2bdb16ca45108149070e5e3965d5f205.png] 

⇒ Height (PM) = (√3 / 2) × 12 = 6√3 cm

⇒ In an equilateral triangle, the centroid A lies on the height (median) PM.

⇒ PA : AM = 2 : 1

⇒ PA = (2 / (2 + 1)) × PM

⇒ PA = (2 / 3) × 6√3 cm

⇒ PA = 4√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Circumradius and Inradius

For an equilateral triangle with side a, the circumradius R = a / √3 and the inradius r = a / (2√3). Note that R = 2r.

Centroid Property

The centroid of any triangle divides each median in a ratio of 2 : 1, where the part connected to the vertex is twice as long as the part connected to the midpoint of the opposite side.

Area of Equilateral Triangle

The area of an equilateral triangle is given by the formula (√3 / 4) × a².</p
